title: Secret in global variable
description:
Security rule — global / superglobal variables whose name suggests a secret (password, token, API key). Globals persist for the whole session.

Based on the PMD rule GlobalVariable — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_ecmascript_bestpractices.html#globalvariable
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Secrets held in globals stay in memory session-wide and surface in Data Viewer / debugging.
rule.remediation: Keep secrets in local scope, fetch them just-in-time, and clear them after use.
